transcript.text: Thanks everyone — we need to lock the CloudScale Summit booth plan this week so design, travel, and staffing can be finalized. Please send me your planning inputs today: Sales, your expected pipeline impact and meeting volume by product line; Product, your launch/demo priorities and who must be onsite; Events, badge logistics, add-on badge costs, and any booth constraints. I’ll make the final call on which product line gets the 20x20 booth and how many staff badges to assign once I have your input.

We have three qualified Beacon deals expected to close within 45 days, and each of those accounts has already booked meetings at the summit specifically to see Beacon rather than Atlas. Based on current meeting commitments, I recommend prioritizing the booth around Beacon and ensuring enough staff coverage for those account meetings.
